name: Dr. A. Mathiazhagan
designation: Professor and Head of the Department
specialization: Ph.D. | Materials Technology and Corrosion Engg, Welding Technology, Composite Technology
bio: “Dr. A. Mathiazhagan, is a Professor in the Dept of Ship Technology, Cochin University. He was Head of the Department from Jan 17th 2019- 16th Jan 2022. He has more than sixty papers published in national and international journals/ conferences and seminar and was coordinator of the conferences and seminars organized in the Department. He has conducted one day workshop on marine corrosion and its control in 2012 at the Department of ship Technology, CUSAT-22. He has given invited technical talks on Corrosion and its Control for ISTE Training program and seminar held in CUSAT, Kochi-22. He has attended more than twenty short-term courses in his chosen area. He completed Short Term Research Training Programmes at IIT Chennai and NIT, Trichy. He has disseminated the corrosion awareness to students of various engineering field and industrial people and inculcated the corrosiono management practices to people working in ship building and offshore industry. he is a member of various academic bodies including BIS, India."

name: Dr. Satheesh Babu P.K
specialization: Ph.D. | Naval Architecture, Marine Hydrodynamics, Ship Design
bio: Naval Architect from the 1988-92 batch of Dept of Ship Technology, CUSAT. Served Indian Navy for 22 years and retired as Commander. Experienced in various fields such as design, building and operation of ships/ submarines, quality control, research and academics.

name: Dr. D. D. Ebenezer

bio: Dr. D. D. Ebenezer teaches B. Tech. students Stability of Ships and Propulsion of Ships, M. Tech students Advanced Engineering Mathematics and Dynamics of Structures, enables several M. Tech. students to do their project work each year, and guides Ph. D. Research Scholars working on Computational Fluid Dynamics.

name: Dr. Rajesh P Nair
specialization: Ph.D. | Finite Element method, Impact Mechanics, Blast Analysis
bio: Working as Assistant Professor at Department of Ship Technology, CUSAT

name: Dr. Manoj T. Issac
specialization: Ph.D. | Experimental and Numerical Hydrodynamics of Unmanned Underwater Vehicles, Dynamics Modeling of Underwater Vehicles using Identification Techniques, Dynamics of Floating Offshore Structures
interests: Experimental and Numerical Hydrodynamics of Unmanned Underwater Vehicles
Dynamics Modeling of Underwater Vehicles using Identification Techniques
bio: Prior to joining CUSAT in August 2015, Dr. Manoj T. Issac worked as an Assistant Professor (on Contract) at the Department of Naval Architecture & Ocean Engineering in the Indian Maritime University (IMU), Visakhapatnam. He holds an undergraduate degree (B. Tech.) in Civil Engineering (1998) from University of Kerala and a masters degree (M. Tech.) in Ocean Engineering (2002) from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras (IIT M). He also worked as a Project Officer, for two years, in the Department of Ocean Engineering, IIT Madras, and had worked on projects sponsored by DRDO labs and other R&D organizations such as NPOL, DRDL, NIOT etc. Dr. Issac received his Ph.D. in Ocean & Naval Architecture Engineering (2011) from Memorial University of Newfoundland (MUN), Canada where he also had a brief stint as a Postdoctoral Fellow (2013). His research interest includes dynamics modeling of unmanned underwater vehicles, experimental hydrodynamics in controlled and uncontrolled environment, dynamics of offshore platforms.

name: Dr. Favas T K
specialization: Ph.D. | Computational Fluid Dynamics, Numerical Heat Transfer, Computational Methods in
bio: Favas.T.K has been working as Assistant Professor at Department of Ship Technology of CUSAT since November, 2020. He worked as Lecturer in Mechanical Engineering at MES College of Engineering Kuttippuram (2004-2008) and as Ad-hoc Faculty at National Institute of Technology Calicut (2013-2018). He also served as Assistant Engineer in Kerala Water Authority (2018-2020). After completing B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering from Government Engineering College Thrissur in 2002, he completed M. Tech in Industrial Refrigeration and Cryogenic Engineering from TKM College of Engineering Kollam with Second Rank under University of Kerala in 2004. He obtained PhD in Mechanical Engineering from National Institute of Technology Calicut in 2018. He has more than 15 publications in refereed journals, national and international conferences.

name: Akram P. A.
specialization: M. Tech. | Finite Element Analysis, Ship Structural Analysis, Offshore Structures
bio: Mr. Akram holds a B. Tech. Degree in Civil Engineering from School of Engineering CUSAT and then joined NIT Calicut for M.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Offshore Structures. Soon after the convocation, he joined Smart Engineering and Design Solutions Ltd., where, he was the part of the division Hull, Outfit and FEA for 8 years. Since late 2020, Mr. Akram is working as a consultant in the Department. His area of expertise includes Finite Element Modelling and Analysis, Ship Structural Analysis and Design, Shock and Vibration Analysis, Computational Fluid Dynamics in OpenFOAM, Computational Programming in Matlab, VBA in Excel, AutoCAD and Siemens FEMAP, and Python, Computational WebApp development, 3D Modelling, animation, photo-realistic rendering and visualisation, stereoscopic spherical rendering - Blender 3D, Autodesk Revit, Game Engine based simulations - Unity 3D.

name: Dr. Aravind K.R
specialization: Ph.D | Inland Waterways Transport, Ship Design, Marine Engineering
bio:
Experienced Assistant Professor in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering with 9+ years of industry and academic experience, specializing in Inland Water Transport, Ship Design, and Marine Engineering. 

Engaged in various committees and projects, including serving as a Technical Expert for the Kerala State Water Transport Department, an Expert Committee Member for the Kerala Shipping and Inland Navigation Corporation, Kerala  Forest and Wildlife Department  and an expert for the Kerala Maritime Board. 

Additionally, contributing expertise to the Kerala Startup Mission and Samagra Shiksha Kerala initiatives. Committed to advancing  in the field of Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering  and making impactful contributions in academia and industry.

name: Dr. Beena Mary John
specialization: Ph.D | Computational Fluid Dynamics, Physical model studies of marine structures, Fluid structure interaction
interests: Physical model studies of marine structures
bio: Beena Mary John received B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering from School of Engineering, CUSAT and M.Tech degree in Computer Aided Structural Analysis and Design from Department of Ship Technology, CUSAT. She completed her Ph.D degree in Marine Structures - Applied Mechanics & Hydraulics in 2018 from National Institute of Technology Karnataka. Before joining CUSAT in 2019, she worked at Tata Consultancy Services, RSET and Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies. She has around 17 publications and is passionate about research in the area of fluid structure interaction, physical and numerical modelling of marine/ocean structures.

name: Dr. Haseena K A
specialization: Ph.D | Renewable/Green Energy Systems-Modeling, Optimization and Integration, Electric Propulsion Systems- Dynamics and Control, Machine Learning and AI Techniques for Energy Systems
interests: Renewable/Green Energy Systems-Modeling, Optimization and Integration
Electric Propulsion Systems- Dynamics and Control
Machine Learning and AI Techniques for Energy Systems
bio: Dr. Haseena K A received Bachelor of Technology in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (LBS College of Engineering, Kannur University) and Master of Technology in Power Systems (Saintgits College of Engineering, Mahatma Gandhi University). Completed Doctor of Philosophy in Dynamic Stability and Control of Renewable Energy-based Power Systems (Awarded in 2019) from the National Institute of Technology Calicut.
